item.title: Meta's Muse Places Calls to Businesses but Many Hang Up on AI
item.description:
Meta's AI agent Muse now lets paying US subscribers delegate phone calls to cable companies, the DMV, and restaurants, with over 10 million users. The feature, tested in September, turns what Google Duplex demoed in 2018 into a standard capability of always-on AI agents. However, many businesses hang up as soon as they detect an AI caller, forcing Meta to adapt, while increasingly realistic synthetic voices make detection harder.

原文标题：Meta 的 Muse 可代用户致电商家，但许多企业一听是 AI 就挂断

Why it matters：这是常驻 AI 智能体从演示走向大规模商用代打电话的关键节点，同时暴露了商家端对 AI 来电的抵触这一真实落地阻力。

item.title: OpenAI Enters Cybersecurity Market with Two Daybreak Agent Products
item.description:
OpenAI launched two security products under its Daybreak brand: Red Team, which uses AI agents to map attack paths from source code and app context and to verify reported flaws and patches, and Defense Factory, which scans codebases and generates deployable fix pull requests with tests. Both run on the new GPT-6 Cyber model, marking OpenAI's formal entry into offensive and defensive cybersecurity.

原文标题：OpenAI 推出 Daybreak 双产品 进军网络安全市场

Why it matters：OpenAI 首次以专用模型加智能体产品组合进入网络安全攻防市场，是智能体落地与产业边界扩张的重要信号。

item.title: DeepMind Paper Shows Prompt Injection Remains Unsolved Against AI Agent Swarms
item.description:
A new Google DeepMind paper introduces Agentic Optimizer, a swarm of eight AI agent teams that share notes and build on each other's injection attempts, breaking the best-defended Gemini 4 Argon on 34% of 100 tool-use tasks. Open-weight models Kimi K3, GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash resisted only 1% of tasks, showing that the near-failure of human red-teaming does not mean prompt injection is solved.

原文标题：DeepMind 新论文揭示提示注入仍未解决

Why it matters：该论文用多智能体自动攻击量化了提示注入的真实风险边界，对构建工具调用型 Agent 的开发者具有直接安全警示价值。

item.title: South Korea Plans Radio Detectors to Curb AI Glasses Cheating
item.description:
South Korea's legislature is reviewing a roughly 6.57 billion KRW budget increase to buy 7,200 radio-signal detectors and deploy over 23,000 specialized proctors against AI-glasses cheating in national qualification exams. Because AI glasses closely resemble ordinary eyewear, this year's college entrance exam still relies mainly on visual inspection, while the education ministry has banned AI glasses from test sites and set penalties of up to three years of exam bans.

item.title: Oklo's Groves-1 Test Reactor Cleared for Full Operations
item.description:
The US Department of Energy has lifted the final operations hold point on Oklo's Groves-1 test reactor near Lockhart, Texas, clearing it to enter research, testing and training operations. The reactor reached first criticality in August, less than a year after groundbreaking, and is one of 11 advanced reactor projects selected for the DOE Nuclear Reactor Pilot Program. Operating experience will feed directly into Oklo's planned Groves-2 Forge isotope facility and its fast fission reactor work.

原文标题：Oklo 试验反应堆获准全面运行

Why it matters：先进核裂变试验堆获准全面运行，为 AI 数据中心供电的核能路线再添实质进展。

item.title: Dalian University of Technology Unveils 20 kg Hydrogen-Powered Unmanned Helicopter

The 12L fuel-cell variant reaches a 3-hour endurance, several times the roughly 30 minutes of conventional lithium-battery drones, and has completed a sea trial cruise in Force 6 winds.

item.title: Reflota Open-Source Tool Recovers Data from NTFS and FAT Disks
item.description:
Reflota is an open-source, read-only data recovery tool for NTFS, FAT32/16/12 and exFAT disks that rebuilds directory trees, finds deleted files, searches by content and recovers lost partitions. Its phased safe-copy mode skips unreadable sectors and resumes after interruption, making it useful when Windows reports a disk as unformatted or a drive is failing. The project is in beta, with some features validated only on test images.

原文标题：Reflota 开源 NTFS/FAT 数据恢复工具

Why it matters：开源只读恢复工具覆盖多种文件系统并支持坏盘分阶段拷贝，对数据抢救场景有直接实用价值。

item.title: Google Open Sources WeatherNext 3 Weather Datasets
item.description:
Google DeepMind has publicly released SatWeave and PARDIG, the two foundational datasets behind its WeatherNext 3 weather model, both hosted on Google Cloud Storage under CC BY 4.0. PARDIG uses a spherical-grid Transformer with ~10 km spatial and 15-minute temporal resolution, outperforming NASA IMERG-Final by over 30% on hourly light-to-moderate precipitation detection and remaining reliable in regions lacking ground radar.

Why it matters：谷歌开源高分辨率全球气象基础数据集，对 AI for Science 与气象建模社区具备直接可用价值。

item.title: llama.cpp 新增 Arm NEON 内核 提示处理提速 6.5 倍
item.description:
llama.cpp 的 tiled K-quant matmul 此前只提供 AVX-512、AVX2 与 AVX 内核，Arm 上的 Q3_K、Q2_K 与 IQ 系列量化格式因此回退到逐次解包权重的慢路径。该贡献补上了基于 NEON SDOT 指令的 Arm 内层内核，在 Neoverse N1 上 IQ3_M 的提示处理从 11.5 tokens/s 提升到 74.5 tokens/s，约 6.5 倍，V1 与 V2 上也有 3.3 至 4.9 倍增益。

Why it matters：为 Arm 服务器补齐低比特量化推理的关键内核，实测提速最高 6.5 倍，直接改善本地与边缘部署体验。
